items.item_text: Current unrestricted California Registered Nurse license
Basic Life Support (BLS) from American Heart Association or America Red Cross
3 years of recent clinical leadership, charge nurse, supervisor, or management experience.

The RN Supervisor in Non-Invasive Cardiodiagnostics provides clinical, operational, and professional nursing leadership for outpatient cardiac diagnostic services, including stress echocardiograms, stress echocardiograms with contrast, routine treadmill stress testing, bubble studies, nuclear cardiology procedures, and other non-invasive cardiovascular diagnostic testing. Utilizing advanced cardiovascular nursing knowledge, critical thinking, and clinical decision-making skills, the RN Supervisor oversees nursing practice, supports cardiac stress testing under approved standardized procedures, and ensures compliance with professional practice standards, patient safety requirements, regulatory guidelines, and UCLA Health policies.

The RN Supervisor collaborates with the Ambulatory Nursing Practice Coordinator, Practice Manager, Cardiology physicians, and interdisciplinary team members to support patient access, quality outcomes, staff development, performance improvement initiatives, regulatory readiness, and exceptional patient experience.

Advanced knowledge of cardiovascular disease processes, non-invasive cardiac diagnostic testing, stress echocardiography, treadmill stress testing, contrast administration, bubble studies, nuclear cardiology, and cardiovascular emergency response
Knowledge of regulatory, accreditation, infection prevention, patient safety, privacy, documentation, emergency equipment, point-of-care, and professional practice requirements.
